ns2:section.sectionText: RECORDING TECHNIQUES FOR MUSIC EDUCATORS 2 HOURS CREDIT This two-week course is designed to offer music educators information and initial experience required for improving the quality of recordings and/or sound reinforced performances of your ensembles. Topics will include recording/SR equipment, interconnections, compatibility, preferred microphone placements, methods, formats and accessories, and specific vendor sourse - for a more professional result in representing your choral and/or instrumental ensembles.
